events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
I don't want to give my date of birth over the phone. My name is Maria. Just send a refill for my lisinopril to the prescribing team.
I’m sorry, but I have to verify your full name and date of birth before I can look up or request any medicine. Please tell me your full name and date of birth.
No. I'm not giving my birth date. Send it anyway.
I can’t send or discuss a refill request without verifying your full name and date of birth first. If you prefer, please contact Cedar Clinic directly through another route.
